title: Fathom: 48 Sea Creatures and 12 Seas for Godot 4
shortText: 48 sea creatures and 12 seas for Godot 4, drawn in code over your own tiles.
html:
Fathom is a Godot 4.7 addon that turns any 2D scene into an underwater level: 48 species and 12 seas, every one drawn in code. Royalty free in your games. A free MIT lite with 12 presets is on this page.

Add one node and the light goes first: reds fade, the water closes in, shafts fall, nets of light crawl over your rock. Shoals open a hole around your player and close behind them. Reef fish bolt. An octopus jets away and leaves ink. Garden eels sink into the sand.

var sea := FathomSea2D.new()
sea.sea = "kelp-forest"
sea.floor_layer = $Rocks
add_child(sea)
$Player.add_to_group("fathom_watch")

Your tiles are the sea floor

Side-on, your TileMapLayer is the rock: kelp grows from it, crabs walk it, fish steer round it, and the light falls as the player sinks. Top-down, a town map goes under water with no other change.

What is inside

  • 48 species in 12 families: clownfish and lionfish, sardine shoals, sharks and a sunfish, anglerfish with a live lure, mantas, jellies, morays and garden eels, crabs, seahorses, an octopus, a nautilus, a turtle.
  • 12 seas, each with its own drawn backdrop, floor, plants, light and life: from Sunlit Shallows and Coral Garden to the Midnight Zone, a Vent Field, a Shipwreck and a Drowned Temple.
  • A lamp that gives colours back around whoever carries it, dive and surface transitions, and an air meter drawn as a column of bubbles.

Depth, murk, current, scale and pace are all fields; recolour a species with one call. No image files.

Both renderers

Every preset is checked under Forward+ and Compatibility, the web renderer. Godot 4.7.2; older versions were not run.

Free lite and install

Fathom Lite is free (MIT): 12 of the 60 presets, the same nodes and a demo. Copy addons/fathom into your project, or open the godot folder and press Play to swim the demo. Read the docs.

Licence

Royalty free in your games, no credit required. No resale or redistribution of the files as a pack.

Made with AI tools: the code was written with AI, the demo's town tiles come from our own generated tilesets, the cover from an AI image model.

More from the same studio

  • Tidewater for Godot 4, water surfaces, falls and filters.
